verdict.rationale: Langfuse supports self-hosting via Docker/local VM (docs-51) which can serve as a de facto sandbox separate from production, and datasets/experiments (docs-8, docs-27, docs-61) allow testing against fixed data rather than live production traffic. However, there is no explicit documented 'sandbox mode', staging environment isolation feature, or first-party guidance on separating sandbox vs production data within Langfuse Cloud. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented data isolation guarantees between test and prod, first-party guidance on non-production testing workflow, independent confirmation of this isolation working in practice.
